coverage: one Open-Meteo reanalysis reference point per Northeast state; not statewide station coverage
humidity_definition: daily mean relative humidity at 2 m (%)
seasonal_baseline: calendar-month baseline estimated from 2021-2024 training data
target: weather anomaly, not road disruption or landslide occurrence
